canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of the 54,668 FHA applications Pennymac Loan Services Llc acted on ended without a credit decision: 9.0% withdrawn by the applicant and 31.5% closed for incompleteness.

required_qualifiers.population: Pennymac Loan Services Llc FHA applications acted on (actions 1-5: originated, approved but not accepted, denied, withdrawn, closed for incompleteness; purchased loans and preapproval requests excluded; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate; process, market, applicant pool and reporting practice are not separable in the record

does_not_establish: that Pennymac Loan Services Llc's process causes applicants to withdraw, or that its applicants cause files to close
that Pennymac Loan Services Llc is better or worse than another lender for a given applicant
Pennymac Loan Services Llc discriminates or violates law
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
